sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text: Product Description Sleepyhead Sense Ortho Ultra – Cool. Smart. Seriously Supportive. When sleep’s your superpower, you need a mattress that doesn’t just keep up—it levels up. The new Sense Ortho Ultra is a total upgrade in comfort tech and cooling design. With a thicker layer of BodyIQ memory foam that intuitively adapts to every body curve (and yes, zero motion transfer), this mattress makes every sleep feel customized. Wrapped in cool-to-the-touch, high GSM knitted fabric, it doesn’t just look luxe—it feels cooler. Perfect for hot sleepers or those who want their bed to double as a chill zone. Beneath the memory foam, a smart profile foam layer with egg tray structure keeps airflow flowing and pressure points zeroed out. It’s also a built-in shock absorber for your spine. And here’s the part your back will thank you for: the firm base layer offers deep orthopedic support and better posture alignment through the night. Toss in a zipper cover that’s removable and washable? It’s sleep hygiene made stylish. Oh—and did we mention the 100-Night Trial and 12-Year Warranty? This mattress doesn’t just promise sleep. It delivers it, smarter. sections.heading: Sense Ortho Ultra – The Mattress That Gets You (and Your Back)
sections.text: Sense Ortho Ultra – The Mattress That Gets You (and Your Back) Not just cool. Not just comfy. But smart enough to know exactly how you sleep. ✔ Cool-to-the-touch knit fabric ✔ BodyIQ memory foam that adapts ✔ Orthopedic support, always aligned ✔ Egg-tray foam for airflow ✔ 12-year warranty + 100-night trial This is comfort that doesn't just sleep. It thinks. Sense Ortho Ultra – Where Smart Sleep Begins You’re not basic. So why should your mattress be? With smarter tech, cooler materials, and better back support, Sense Ortho Ultra brings a whole new level of chill to your bedroom. Built for people who want more from their mattress—more breathability, more support, and more reason to never hit snooze again. Choose your comfort identity: BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam: The BodyIQ memory foam layer understands your curves and cradles them with zero motion transfer. Cool to the Touch: High GSM knit fabric feels cool at first touch, and stays breathable all night. Orthopedic Support: The orthopedic base + profile foam with egg-tray design = pressure relief + spinal alignment. For Hot Sleepers, Hectic Sleepers & Hygiene Heroes Sense Ortho Ultra brings the full package—cool comfort, custom contouring, and serious support. It’s not just about feeling soft—it’s about waking up with zero joint complaints and no 3 AM sweat sessions. Wrapped in a high-GSM knit cover that’s removable and washable, it’s a mattress that keeps up with your sleep and your schedule. Cools You Down. Lifts You Up. Cleans Up Easy Let’s break it down. The surface is high-GSM knitted fabric—soft, luxe, and cooling like a breeze. Next comes the BodyIQ memory foam. It’s not just soft, it’s responsive—adapting to how you sleep, move, and recover. Then you’ve got the egg-tray foam—a shock absorber for your spine and a ventilation hero for airflow. And anchoring it all? A firm orthopedic base for alignment that lasts longer than your longest nap. Easy-to-remove zipper cover? That’s just the hygiene cherry on top.

sections.heading: FAQs
sections.text: FAQs 1. What is Sense Ortho Ultra Mattress? Sense Ortho Ultra is an 8-inch mattress with cool-to-touch high-GSM knit fabric cover, BodyIQ orthopedic memory foam layer, and firm orthopedic base foam. You get targeted orthopedic support paired with cooling fabric for refreshing sleep every night. 2. What problem does it solve? It solves back pain, night sweats, partner disturbance, adaptive contouring, superior airflow, zero motion transfer, and zoned spinal alignment for deeper sleep. 3. Who is it best for? Best for back pain sufferers, couples, hot sleepers, and those needing Medium firm yet responsive support with hygiene features like washable cover and hypoallergenic materials. 4. How does Sense Ortho Ultra Mattress work? BodyIQ foam contours to your body for pressure relief; egg-tray foam circulates air to regulate temperature; orthopedic base supports your spine; cooling fabric wicks moisture. 5. How is it different from alternatives? Differs from standard memory foams with BodyIQ adaptive tech for faster response, egg-tray cooling (better than gel-infused), zoned ortho support, and washable zipper cover for longevity. 6. How does it feel? The mattress feels medium-firm that offers deep orthopedic support and optimal posture alignment through the night. 7. Does it come with a warranty? Yes, 12-year warranty, plus 100-night risk-free trial. 8. How to care for this product? Use a mattress protector, keep it on a flat, supportive base, rotate periodically if recommended. Avoid folding or standing on the mattress.
